item.tib: stag la spu gri dmar nag yang gsang mthar thug gi gdam pa'i zabs gnad mchod rten dkar nag sogs kyi man ngag srog gi rgya mdud
item.coloph: ces stag la spu gri dmar nag yang gsang mthar thug gi gdam pa'i zab gnad mchod rten dkar nag sogs kyi man ngag srog gi rgya mdud 'di ni/ snyigs ma'i kho bo kun grol grags pa 'ja' tshon snying po can gyis/ shar sna zla ba shem klung a khod bon gyi 'du gnas su na tshod ldan gyi lor mgu byed zla ba'i dmar phyogs su bgyis pa bstan dgra'i srog gshed du gyur cig/
